requests.query: The Ice Class Regulations of 2010 (TRAFI/31298/03.04.01.00/2010) apply to ships contracted for construction on or after 1 January 2012 but before 1 January 2019.

Construction contract date must be between 2012‑01‑01 (inclusive) and 2019‑01‑01 (exclusive) for applicability of the 2010 Ice Class Regulations. Ships built under the 2010 Ice Class Regulations must have applicableIceClassRegulationEdition set to iceClassRegulationEdition2010.
